title: reliab stack profile
description: reliability-profile.yaml: binds the reliab method to one codebase. See knowledge/concepts/stack-profile.md.

verified_on.description: Date stage S0 last passed on this codebase.

target.description: Runtime a planned move goes to, or none.

shared_lib.description: Lowest runtime both current and target support.

paths.description: Path classes. A file matching none of them counts as product.

protected_paths.description: Oracles that change only with human approval (R2).

protected_commands.description: Regular expressions (RE2) matching shell commands that approve or rewrite a protected oracle without naming its path, such as a snapshot tool's accept command. Agents are denied them (R2).

protected_edits.description: Regular expressions (RE2) matching text an agent may not add to any file, such as a snapshot tool's auto-accept switch in test code. Edits that add a match are denied (R2). A hook cannot see behavior a test opts into at runtime by other means; gate protected stays the backstop.

base.description: Ref a branch is measured from: changed_only commands, {base}, report summary. Default: the first of origin/HEAD, origin/main, main, master with a merge base.

freshness_exclude.description: Paths whose changes do not make a report stale.

mutation_baseline.description: Repo-relative path of the mutation baseline file (schemas/baseline.schema.json): a recorded score per scope that mutation runs must not fall below. It must match protected_paths: a person writes it with reliab baseline write and commits it (R2).

roles.description: One entry per tool role T1-T14: a filling, or applicable: false with a reason.

commands.description: What verify runs. The only place a tool is named. Placeholders: {impacted}, {cases}, {seed}, {scope}, {base}, and {capture} (characterize only: the directory to write transcripts into).

impacted.description: What {impacted} expands to. Changed files matching map globs contribute their args; any unmatched changed file means all.

all.description: Arguments that select every test, e.g. ./... or --workspace.

separator.description: Joins the args of several matched map entries. Default a space; a test filter may need e.g. ' | '.

corrections.description: Append-only: role fillings that failed the verification protocol.

oneOf.description: Shorthand: run this; judge by exit code only.

format.description: Format of the output file, which selects the reader. findings is reliab's own format, written by an external adapter for any other tool.

output.description: Path or glob of the output file(s), relative to the repo root. Every match is read; matches are removed before the command runs.

changed_only.description: For a mutation-report or cobertura output: keep only the lines changed since the base (findings and counts).

relevant_when.description: Globs of the files that make this command relevant. In the inner and prepr tiers it is skipped, with the reason, when no file changed since the base matches; never in nightly, under --only, or when the base cannot be resolved. See knowledge/decisions/relevance-skips.md.

needs.description: Per-run inputs the command cannot run without: tests (verify --tests, {tests}, RELIAB_TESTS) or mutation_tests (verify --mutation-tests, {mutation_tests}, RELIAB_MUTATION_TESTS). When one is empty and the command is relevant, verify skips it with reason needs-input and the run is incomplete. See knowledge/decisions/named-tests.md.

threshold.description: mutation_* commands only: the minimum mutation score, in percent, of what the command measured (changed code, for a changed-code command). Below it verify adds a below-threshold finding and reliab gate mutation fails.

run.description: Overrides the built-in command list for this tier.
